scientific_integrity: Prior stationary law and entropy-production formula are credited to arXiv:2209.09721; generic spectral and long-time transport ingredients are not asserted original. Self-review only; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary two-particle chase-and-run model with smooth periodic forces, independent Brownian noises, unwrapped positions and known D_1,D_2,L. Only Fourier power, not phase, is identified from an ideal exact covariance curve; noise-robust inverse stability and multi-particle generalizations are unproved.
title: Exact spectral tomography and a sharp transport–dissipation frontier for a nonreciprocal Brownian pair
